text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Daaaaaah! This is all... for Funabashi, 
the place that raised me!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: (—!! Furio is strong...!)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
(The old me... just wanted to have fun and 
entertain people. But now...!)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Transcend's running—has changed. It's not 
just the cleverness backed by data 
anymore.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A strong core formed at her center. It was 
something akin to "determination."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*... What is this... What 
is all this...?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
So this is what it means to run with 
something on your shoulders... while 
feeling someone else's presence...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I don't know... I don't know, but... 
still...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: It's super…… thrilling!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Tran-san♪ Umm! How should I put 
it...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Was she always like this!? I thought she 
used to be more of a calm, collected 
racer.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
No, the truth is, I'm in the middle of a 
mini makeover. Because in my house...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I definitely want to give it my all! 
Because I have a reason to feel that way!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: —Tran-san.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Ah, Furio. Thanks for today!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
We got to collect data, too, and more than 
anything else...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I really wanted to harmonize with you, 
Furio. To unite our shared desire to race 
for someone else into one.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Um... Just one thing. I'm so sorry.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I understand now. Your feelings are just 
as strong as mine.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: —Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Staaaaare...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And thus, the Cinema Gun's restoration was 
complete. We were able to retrieve the 
data on the Big Three once more.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
With this, all the data has been restored. 
All that's left is to analyze it and make 
it my own...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Nobody can stand against us. Right, 
Trainy?"
choice_data_list:
Yeah, let's use that to prove your 
complete comeback.

Yeah, let's use that to prove you're 
completely back.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Transcend has now fully recovered to her 
condition just before that disaster."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And finally, we must prove that people can 
get back on their feet, and that 
heartbreak can be overcome.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
So much has happened this year... Now, 
which race will be the grand finale...?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I wonder which race? Maybe the 
end-of-year Tokyo Daishoten, or...
choice_data_list:
No, your finishing touches don't belong 
there.

No, that's not where your final touches 
belong.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though lost in all the confusion... I must 
not forget the goals I set at the start of 
the year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Yes, it is—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
First is completing the Cinemagun's data. 
And then, based on that analyzed data...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Back-to-back Champions Cup wins!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Right! That was it! Back-to-back victories 
that no one has ever achieved!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Was that the landmark we were aiming for, 
I wonder?"
choice_data_list:
Why not dedicate it? To that precious 
place.

Won't you dedicate it? To that precious 
place.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... yeah, you're right. I'm sure that 
is... the best cheer of all.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Even if we couldn't do it before, we can 
now! And so can those girls, and those 
people!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Let's do it, let's win this, Trai-chan. I 
don't know what it is, but I...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I can't stop shaking! I've never wanted to 
run so badly in my life!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I started racing purely for fun. But 
now—it's more than that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of the bonds nurtured, 
carrying feelings akin to a mission, she 
takes on the challenge of defending her 
Champions Cup title.
